propositions: The divergent_implementation axis is mis-calibrated: it fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings and ~90% of the 1,307 omitted-scope findings are graded none despite being the axis's stated purpose.

Replace divergent_implementation's ordinal grading (none/low/medium/high) with a closed Literal set (none, contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration), flooring at 0.85 for the first two and contributing below 0.60 for incomplete_enumeration.
Reject high-cost LLM-based calibration; ADR 0054 restricts calibration to zero-marginal-cost corpus replay and dogfooding, narrowing ADR 0036's A/B clause.
A production-impact severity floor (Fix 2) would escape 1.9x more findings from the novelty convergence floor (0.4) than the divergence grading fix, risking non-termination of the remediation loop.

Structural changes required: introduce DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 map, exclude divergent_implementation from generic _SEV01 loop, add _PLAN_GRADED_AXES set, and update hard-override logic to check _DIVERGENCE_FLOOR_GRADES membership.

Bump IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION to plan-v4; migrate all fixtures and prompts (plan_review_verifier.md, plan_review_verifier_agentic.md, plan_review_G7.md) to the new symbolic grades and document the three-way split explicitly.
